transcript: Speaker A: mujhe maaf kar do. ye unke aakhri shabd the aur phir vo chale gaye. wapas kabhi nahi aaye. ["Forgive me." those were his last words and then he left. Never came back.] Speaker B: Oh that must have been so tough, Kavita. phir aapne khud ko kaise sambhala? [Oh that must have been so tough, Kavita. Then how did you handle yourself?] Speaker A: mera naam kavita hai. do bachchon ki maa hun. pati ke jaane ke baad na job thi, na savings. maine kaam dhoondhna shuru kiya. par har jagah ek hi cheez par rejection milta tha ki aapki English acchi nahi hai. [My name is Kavita. I am a mother of two children. After my husband left, there was no job, no savings. I started looking for work. But everywhere I got rejected for one thing, that your English is not good.] Speaker B: aur phir aap mujhse mili on SpeakEasy app. [And then you met me on SpeakEasy app.] Speaker A: haan vani, mujhe laga tum bhi baaki duniya ki tarah meri galat English par hansogi. par tumne bina judge kiye roz mere saath bas 15 minute practice ki. meri har galti pyaar se sudhaari. [Yes Vani, I thought you too, like the rest of the world, would laugh at my wrong English. But without judging, you practiced with me for just 15 minutes every day. Corrected my every mistake with love.] Speaker B: aur aaj day 30 par result kya hai? [And today on day 30, what is the result?] Speaker A: aaj mera darr khatm ho gaya. maine work from home job clear kar li hai. apne bachchon ki school fees aur rent ab main khud uthati hun. mujhe ab kisi ke sahaare ki zarurat nahi. [Today my fear is gone. I have cleared a work from home job. Now I pay my children's school fees and rent myself. I don't need anyone's support anymore.] Speaker B: I am so proud of you kavita. Speaker A: agar aap bhi bina kisi par depend hue apna confidence badhaana chahti hain to abhi neeche diye button par click karke Speakeasy app download kijiye. [If you too want to increase your confidence without depending on anyone, then click on the button below right now and download the Speakeasy app.] Speaker C: Abhi Speakeasy app download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download Speakeasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
on_screen_text: Speakeasy AI. Speak English Easily with Speakeasy AI. Install Now. GET IT ON Google Play. Download on the App Store.
summary: A touching testimonial of a single mother who overcame job rejections due to poor English by practicing daily with the Speakeasy AI avatar. She successfully secured a work-from-home job to support her family. The ad encourages viewers to download the Speakeasy app to build their confidence and speak fluent English.
